title: The Deposit Share Where Protection Is Written Over a Resort Lodging Reservation
content:
A Resort Lodging reservation with a protection plan written over it carries a lighter deposit share, because the collective already stands behind part of the stay. The plan records read are the household's protection plans under Pass and Trip Protection: their standing, the holding each is written over, and the benefit remaining on each.

Where a protection plan standing active is written over the reservation and the benefit remaining on it reaches the room rate standing on the folio, the protected deposit share of 20 percent is taken.

Where a protection plan standing active is written over the reservation and the benefit remaining on it falls short of the room rate standing on the folio, the part protected deposit share of 27.5 percent is taken.

Where no protection plan stands active over the reservation, the unit type's deposit share is taken.

| What the protection records show | The share taken |
| --- | --- |
| A plan standing active over this reservation, benefit remaining reaching the room rate standing on the folio | 20 percent |
| A plan standing active over this reservation, benefit remaining falling short of that room rate | 27.5 percent |
| No plan standing active over this reservation | the unit type's published deposit share |

### Reading the benefit against the folio (hypothetical plans)

On a folio carrying 2400.00 USD of room rate, a protection plan standing active over the reservation with 2400.00 USD of benefit remaining reaches that room rate exactly, and the protected deposit share of 20 percent is taken; reaching it is enough, and the benefit need not exceed it.

On the same folio, a plan standing active with 1800.00 USD of benefit remaining falls short of the room rate standing, and the part protected deposit share of 27.5 percent is taken.

A plan that stands active but is written over a different holding of the household is not written over this reservation, so neither of the first two tiers is answered and the unit type's published deposit share is taken.
